en: n. in some religions, the place where bad people go after they die; a very unpleasant experience or situation; (informal) used to emphasize anger or surprise
ex: Being stuck in the traffic jam was hell.
卡在車陣裡簡直像地獄。

en: a hard hat that protects your head, worn by soldiers, motorcyclists, builders or when playing certain sports
ex: You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
騎腳踏車時一定要戴安全帽。

en: n. a small sign or piece of information that helps you guess something; a suggestion given in an indirect way; a very small amount; v. to suggest something in an indirect way
ex: She gave me a hint about where the gift was hidden.
她給了我一個禮物藏在哪裡的暗示。

en: v. to pay someone to work for you; to pay money to use something for a short time; n. the act of hiring someone; the money you pay to use something
ex: The company plans to hire fifty new workers.
公司打算僱用五十名新員工。

en: a. important or famous in history; likely to be remembered for a long time
ex: The two leaders signed a historic agreement.
兩位領袖簽署了一份歷史性的協議。

en: a. having an empty space inside; (of a sound) deep and echoing; (of words or feelings) not sincere; n. a small valley or hole in the ground; v. to make something hollow
ex: The tree trunk was hollow inside.
那棵樹的樹幹裡面是空心的。

en: a. feeling sad because you are away from your home and family
ex: She felt homesick during her first semester abroad.
她出國的第一學期很想家。

en: the town or city where you were born or spent your childhood
ex: He returned to his hometown after many years abroad.
他在國外多年後回到了故鄉。

en: n. great respect and admiration; a reason to be proud; a title or prize given to someone; v. to show respect for someone; to keep a promise or agreement; to accept a check or credit card
ex: It is an honor to meet you.
很榮幸見到你。

en: a. feeling that something good will happen; giving a feeling of hope; n. a person who hopes to succeed
ex: We are hopeful that the weather will improve tomorrow.
我們希望明天天氣會好轉。

en: n. a hard pointed part that grows on the head of animals such as cows and deer; a musical instrument that you blow; a device in a car that makes a loud noise
ex: The driver pressed the horn to warn the child.
司機按喇叭警告那個孩子。
ph: on the horns of a dilemma

en: a. very unpleasant or shocking; very bad; causing fear or horror
ex: The weather was horrible all week.
整個星期的天氣都糟透了。

en: n. a strong feeling of fear and shock; something that causes this feeling; (informal) a very naughty child; a. relating to scary stories or films
ex: She screamed in horror when she saw the accident.
她看到意外現場時驚恐地尖叫。

en: a. happening or done every hour; calculated by the hour; adv. every hour; very often
ex: The bus service runs on an hourly basis.
公車每小時發一班。

en: n. the quality of being funny; the ability to see that things are funny; a person's mood; v. to do what someone wants in order to keep them happy
ex: He has a great sense of humor and makes everyone laugh.
他很有幽默感，總是逗大家發笑。

en: n. a small simple house or shelter, often made of wood or mud; a small temporary building; v. to live in a hut
ex: They stayed in a mountain hut overnight.
他們在山中的小屋過了一夜。

en: n. the ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind; the ability to think of new and interesting ideas; something that you imagine and is not real
ex: Children have a wonderful imagination.
孩子們有很棒的想像力。

en: v. to bring goods from another country into your own country; to move information into a computer program from another source; n. a product that is brought from another country; the meaning or importance of something
ex: Taiwan imports a large amount of oil.
台灣進口大量石油。

en: v. to make someone feel admiration or respect; to make someone remember you in a good way; to press a mark or pattern into something; n. a mark or an effect left on something
ex: Her performance impressed all the judges.
她的表現讓所有評審印象深刻。

en: a. used, done or existing inside a building
ex: We play indoor games when it rains.
下雨時我們玩室內遊戲。

en: a. relating to industry; (of a country) having many industries; used in industry; n. a person who works in a factory; shares in industrial companies
ex: The city has a large industrial area with many factories.
這座城市有一個設有許多工廠的大工業區。

en: a. lower in quality, status or importance; not as good as something else; n. a person who has a lower position than someone else; something of poor quality
ex: This product is inferior to the one we bought last year.
這個產品比我們去年買的差。

en: n. facts or details about someone or something; knowledge gained from study or experience; a place where you can ask for help; a legal statement accusing someone of a crime
ex: Please send me more information about the course.
請寄給我更多關於這門課的資訊。

en: n. physical harm to a person or animal; harm to someone's feelings or reputation; (in law) harm that someone suffers because of another person
ex: He suffered a serious injury in the football game.
他在足球比賽中受了重傷。

en: n. a small hotel or pub, usually in the countryside, where you can stay or have food and drink; v. to stay at an inn
ex: We spent the night at a cozy inn in the mountains.
我們在山上一間舒適的小旅館過夜。

en: a. inside or near the center of something; (of feelings) not shown to others; n. the inside or central part of something
ex: She found inner peace through meditation.
她透過冥想找到內心的平靜。

en: a. not guilty of a crime; not having much experience of life; not intended to cause harm; n. someone who has no experience or is not guilty
ex: The jury found the man innocent of all charges.
陪審團認定那名男子所有罪名都不成立。
ph: 在證明有罪之前視為無罪

en: v. to look at something carefully to check that it is correct or in good condition; to officially visit a place to check that rules are followed
ex: The mechanic inspected the car before returning it.
技師在把車還給客人之前仔細檢查了一遍。

en: n. a person whose job is to officially check that something is correct or in good condition; a police officer of middle rank
ex: A health inspector visited the restaurant last week.
衛生稽查員上週到訪這家餐廳。

en: v. to stop someone from speaking by saying something yourself; to stop a process for a short time; to make something stop for a while; n. a signal that makes a computer stop what it is doing
ex: Please don't interrupt me while I'm speaking.
我說話的時候請不要打斷我。

en: a person who has thought of or made something that did not exist before
ex: Thomas Edison was the inventor of the light bulb.
愛迪生是電燈泡的發明者。

en: to try to find out the facts about something such as a crime, accident or problem; to study something carefully
ex: The police are investigating the cause of the fire.
警方正在調查火災的起因。

en: n. a written or spoken request to come to a party, wedding or other event; an act of asking someone to do something; something that makes you want to do something
ex: She sent out wedding invitations to all her friends.
她寄出了給所有朋友的婚禮邀請函。

en: n. the hard white substance that forms the tusks of an elephant; a creamy white color; a. made of ivory; having a creamy white color
ex: The piano keys were made of ivory.
這架鋼琴的琴鍵是象牙做的。

en: n. a place where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while waiting for trial; v. to put someone in jail
ex: He was sent to jail for three years.
他被判入獄三年。

en: n. a glass or pottery container with a wide opening, used for storing food; a sudden shock or shake; an unpleasant sound; v. to shock or surprise someone; to have an unpleasant effect; to hit something with a sudden hard force
ex: She put the jam in a glass jar.
她把果醬裝進玻璃罐。
ph: caught with one's hand in the cookie jar

en: n. the bone below the mouth that holds the teeth; the lower part of the face; v. (informal) to talk for a long time; to scold someone
ex: The boxer was hit hard on the jaw.
那位拳擊手下巴被重重打中。

en: n. a kind of music that was developed by African American musicians and has a strong rhythm; (informal) pretentious or exciting things; v. to play jazz music; to make something more exciting
ex: They listened to live jazz at a small bar.
他們在一間小酒吧聽現場爵士樂。

en: n. a strong small car with four-wheel drive that can travel over rough ground; v. to travel in a jeep
ex: We rented a jeep to drive through the desert.
我們租了一輛吉普車開過沙漠。

en: n. a soft sweet food made from fruit juice and sugar that is cooked until it sets; a soft substance like this; v. to become soft and set like jelly
ex: She spread strawberry jelly on the toast.
她在吐司上塗了草莓果醬。
